name: Naviti Island
bestView: The northern end of the island at low tide, when the reef flat opens a walkable path between coral gardens
bestMonths: May to October: dry, 26°C, calm water
crowd: Resort day-trips cluster at Sawa-i-Lau caves mid-morning. Island villages stay empty all day
kid: Fijians adore kids. Village visits, hermit-crab races, and water warm enough to stay in until dark
adventure: Reef snorkel off the resort sand
priceNote: Island resorts include meals in the rate. A kava ceremony tip is a F$5 note, not more.

visa.note: Visa-free entry for most Western nationals, 4 months on arrival.
